legacyProfiles.title: Servers of the HelixCoreServer package
legacyProfiles.text: These servers were set up with the Perforce P4 Server (p4d) package. Import them to manage them here. Their root and their depots stay where they are.
legacyProfiles.loadError: The servers to import could not be loaded: {message}
legacyProfiles.dismissError: The server could not be dismissed: {message}
legacyProfiles.dismissHint: Hide this server for good. It is left untouched.

instance.autoStartHint: Starts the server whenever the manager starts, unless it already runs.
instance.autoStartError: The setting could not be saved: {message}

createInstance.title: New server
createInstance.name: Name
createInstance.nameHint: Also used as the server ID.
createInstance.versionsError: The p4d versions could not be loaded: {message}
createInstance.rootPathHint: Leave empty to let the manager choose a folder.
createInstance.caseSensitiveHint: Cannot be changed once the server exists.
createInstance.unicodeHint: Cannot be undone once the server exists.
createInstance.autoStartHint: Starts the server whenever the manager starts. Can be changed later.
createInstance.superUserHint: The administrator of the new server. Until you add other users, it is the only account that can manage it.
createInstance.passwordHint: Only given to p4d, never stored by the manager.
createInstance.error: The server could not be created: {message}

rules.nameFormat: Start with a letter, then up to 31 letters, digits, '-' or '_'.
rules.userNameFormat: Start with a letter, then up to 63 letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.

importInstance.title: Import {name}
importInstance.rootHint: Kept as it is. The server ID stored in the database is kept too.
importInstance.versionHint: The database is upgraded to this version and cannot go back: choose the version the server ran, or a newer one.
importInstance.caseSensitiveHint: Must match the way the server was created. Suggested from its profile.
importInstance.unicodeNote: The Unicode mode is read from the database.
importInstance.warning: Stop the server in the HelixCoreServer package first. A checkpoint of the database is saved to the folder of the instance before the upgrade.
importInstance.error: The server could not be imported: {message}

deleteInstance.title: Delete {name}?
deleteInstance.text: The server is stopped if it runs, then removed from the manager. This cannot be undone.
deleteInstance.deleteFilesHint: Deletes the logs and, when the manager chose it, the root directory with the depots. A root directory you gave at creation is kept.
deleteInstance.keptFiles: The files stay on disk, in {path}.
deleteInstance.error: The server could not be deleted: {message}
